items.title: CoSearch: Joint Training of Reasoning and Document Ranking via Reinforcement Learning for Agentic Search
items.title_zh: CoSearch：面向智能体搜索的推理与文档排序联合强化学习训练
items.summary: CoSearch jointly trains a multi-step reasoning agent and a generative document ranker with GRPO, after a preliminary experiment found up to a 26.8% relative F1 gap between oracle and fixed retrieval across seven QA benchmarks. A semantic grouping strategy clusters sub-queries by token similarity to form valid ranker optimization groups, and a composite reward combines ranking quality with trajectory-level outcomes; gains are consistent on seven single- and multi-hop QA benchmarks.

items.title: Introducing GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
items.title_zh: 推出 GPT-Rosalind：面向生命科学研究的前沿推理模型
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-Rosalind, a frontier reasoning model built to accelerate drug discovery, genomics analysis, protein reasoning and scientific research workflows.

items.title: HiveMind: OS-Inspired Scheduling for Concurrent LLM Agent Workloads
items.title_zh: HiveMind：面向并发 LLM 智能体负载的 OS 启发式调度
items.summary: HiveMind is a transparent HTTP proxy that applies five OS-inspired primitives, including admission control, rate-limit tracking, AIMD backpressure and priority queuing, to concurrent LLM agent workloads without changing agent code. Across 5-50 concurrent agents, uncoordinated runs failed at 72-100% rates while HiveMind cut failures to 0-18% and eliminated 48-100% of wasted compute, adding under 3ms of overhead.

items.title: From Plan to Action: How Well Do Agents Follow the Plan?
items.title_zh: 从计划到行动：智能体在多大程度上遵循计划？
items.summary: The first extensive systematic analysis of plan compliance examines 21,120 SWE-agent trajectories across four LLMs on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro under eight plan variations, finding that without an explicit plan agents fall back on incomplete or overfit internalized workflows. A standard plan improves issue resolution, periodic reminders reduce violations, and a subpar plan hurts performance more than no plan at all.

items.title: APEX-MEM: Agentic Semi-Structured Memory with Temporal Reasoning for Long-Term Conversational AI
items.title_zh: APEX-MEM：面向长期对话 AI 的智能体半结构化记忆与时序推理
items.summary: APEX-MEM structures conversations as temporally grounded events in a domain-agnostic property graph, stores them append-only to preserve temporal evolution, and uses a multi-tool retrieval agent that resolves conflicting or evolving information at query time. It reaches 88.88% accuracy on LOCOMO question answering and 86.2% on LongMemEval, outperforming session-aware state-of-the-art approaches.

items.title: Beyond Perception Errors: Semantic Fixation in Large Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 超越感知错误：大型视觉语言模型中的语义固着
items.summary: The paper introduces semantic fixation, the tendency of vision-language models to retain a default interpretation even when a prompt specifies an alternative equally valid mapping, and builds VLM-Fix, a benchmark over four abstract strategy games with paired standard and inverse rules. Across 14 open and closed VLMs accuracy favored standard rules, neutral alias prompts narrowed the inverse-rule gap, semantically loaded aliases reopened it, and late-layer activation steering partially recovered performance.

items.title: Narrative over Numbers: The Identifiable Victim Effect and its Amplification Under Alignment and Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 叙事胜过数字：大语言模型中的可识别受害者效应及其在对齐与推理下的放大
items.summary: Across 51,955 API trials with 16 frontier models, the study finds the identifiable victim effect is prevalent but modulated by alignment: instruction-tuned models show extreme effects (Cohen's d up to 1.56) while reasoning-specialized models invert it (down to d=-0.85). Standard chain-of-thought prompting nearly triples the effect size, and only utilitarian chain-of-thought reliably eliminates it.

items.title: ViLL-E: Video LLM Embeddings for Retrieval
items.title_zh: ViLL-E：面向检索的视频 LLM 嵌入
items.summary: ViLL-E is a unified VideoLLM architecture whose embedding mechanism can spend more computation on complex videos and stop early on easy ones, trained in three stages that combine generative and contrastive learning. The authors report average gains of 7% in temporal localization and up to 4% in video retrieval, plus zero-shot improvements of 5% in composed video retrieval and 2% in retrieval from long text.

items.title: Listening Alone, Understanding Together: Collaborative Context Recovery for Privacy-Aware AI
items.title_zh: 独自聆听，共同理解：面向隐私感知 AI 的协作式上下文恢复
items.summary: CONCORD is a privacy-aware asynchronous assistant-to-assistant framework that enforces owner-only speech capture via real-time speaker verification, then recovers missing context through spatio-temporal resolution, information-gap detection and minimal relationship-aware queries. Across a multi-domain dialogue dataset it achieves 91.4% recall in gap detection, 96% relationship classification accuracy and a 97% true negative rate in privacy-sensitive disclosure decisions.

items.title: Text-Attributed Knowledge Graph Enrichment with Large Language Models for Medical Concept Representation
items.title_zh: 用大语言模型丰富文本属性知识图谱，实现医学概念表示
items.summary: MedCo is an LLM-powered graph learning framework that builds a medical-code knowledge graph, enriches it into a text-attributed graph with generated node descriptions and edge rationales, and jointly trains a LoRA-tuned LLaMA encoder with a heterogeneous graph neural network to improve medical concept representation.

items.title: Correct Prediction, Wrong Steps? Consensus Reasoning Knowledge Graph for Robust Chain-of-Thought Synthesis
items.title_zh: 预测正确、步骤错误？面向稳健思维链合成的共识推理知识图谱
items.summary: CRAFT aggregates consensus components shared across multiple candidate reasoning traces to synthesize improved chain-of-thought traces, motivated by evidence that high label accuracy does not guarantee correct intermediate reasoning and that giving the model the correct answer does not consistently improve reasoning quality. It improves label-prediction accuracy on logical and mathematical benchmarks and yields higher-quality post-processed traces under fine-grained evaluation.

items.title: Shuffle the Context: RoPE-Perturbed Self-Distillation for Long-Context Adaptation
items.title_zh: 打乱上下文：面向长上下文适配的 RoPE 扰动自蒸馏
items.summary: The paper shows long-context adaptation remains brittle because accuracy depends on the absolute placement of relevant evidence, and proposes a regularizer that creates alternative views of a training sequence by perturbing RoPE indices and trains for consistent predictions via self-distillation. It reports up to 12.04% improvement on RULER-64K for Llama-3-8B and 2.71% on RULER-256K for Qwen-3-4B after SFT, plus better length extrapolation.

items.title: Predict and Reconstruct: Joint Objectives for Self-Supervised Language Representation Learning
items.title_zh: 预测与重建：自监督语言表示学习的联合目标
items.summary: The authors combine a JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with a standard masked-language-modeling objective over one shared encoder, balanced by a learnable scalar. Pre-trained on English Wikipedia under matched compute, the hybrid encoder produces significantly more uniform embeddings and encodes less surface-level lexical information at similar linear-probe accuracy.

items.title: Audio2Tool: Speak, Call, Act -- A Dataset for Benchmarking Speech Tool Use
items.title_zh: Audio2Tool：评测语音工具调用的数据集
items.summary: Audio2Tool is a dataset of roughly 30,000 queries for evaluating tool calling by speech language models across smart car, smart home and wearables domains. It spans direct commands through multi-intent and needle-in-a-haystack tasks, uses zero-shot voice cloning and varied noise profiles, and shows strong simple-command performance but significant degradation under compositional and acoustic challenges.

items.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Radiology Clinical Hierarchy for CT Report Generation
items.title_zh: MARCH：面向 CT 报告生成的多智能体放射科临床层级
items.summary: MARCH emulates a radiology department's hierarchy, using a Resident Agent for initial drafting with multi-scale CT feature extraction, Fellow Agents for retrieval-augmented revision, and an Attending Agent that runs stance-based consensus discourse to resolve diagnostic discrepancies. On RadGenome-ChestCT it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in clinical fidelity and linguistic accuracy.

items.title: Graph-of-Agents: A Graph-based Framework for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
items.title_zh: Graph-of-Agents：基于图的多智能体 LLM 协作框架
items.summary: Graph-of-Agents models multi-agent LLM collaboration as a graph, sampling relevant agents from model cards, ordering them by comparing their responses, passing messages in both directions and pooling results. With a pool of six models it outperforms multi-agent baselines while using only three agents, according to the authors.

items.title: SeekerGym: A Benchmark for Reliable Information Seeking
items.title_zh: SeekerGym：面向可靠信息检索的基准
items.summary: SeekerGym benchmarks how completely AI agents retrieve information, using documents such as Wikipedia articles and ML survey papers as tasks, and also measures whether agents quantify how much may be missing. The best methods retrieve 42.5% of passages on Wikipedia and 29.2% on ML surveys.

items.title: Beyond Static Snapshots: A Grounded Evaluation Framework for Language Models at the Agentic Frontier
items.title_zh: 超越静态快照：面向智能体前沿的语言模型扎根评估框架
items.summary: The paper argues current LLM evaluation suffers from distributional, temporal, scope and process invalidity, and proposes the Grounded Continuous Evaluation framework with ISOPro as a reference implementation. ISOPro replaces a learned reward model with a deterministic verifier and updates LoRA adapters on CPU; across twelve cells it yields a mean gain of +9.0 points versus -1.5 for GRPO-LoRA at consumer-budget settings, with held-out MBPP generalization reaching 40% on two of three architectures.

items.title: Peerispect: Claim Verification in Scientific Peer Reviews
items.title_zh: Peerispect：同行评审中的论断验证
items.summary: Peerispect extracts check-worthy claims from peer reviews, retrieves evidence from the manuscript and verifies claims through natural language inference, highlighting supporting evidence in an interface. It is released as a modular information-retrieval pipeline with a public demo and API.

items.title: Long-Horizon Plan Execution in Large Tool Spaces through Entropy-Guided Branching
items.title_zh: 大工具空间中的长程计划执行：熵引导分支搜索
items.summary: The authors introduce SLATE, a large-scale context-aware e-commerce benchmark for tool-integrated agents, and find that current agents struggle with self-correction and search efficiency. They propose Entropy-Guided Branching, an uncertainty-aware search method that expands decision branches where predictive entropy is high, improving both task success and computational efficiency on SLATE.

items.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Must Move Beyond Factual Grounding to Represent Diverse Opinions
items.title_zh: 检索增强生成必须超越事实依据，以呈现多元观点
items.summary: This position paper argues that RAG's assumption that queries have correct answers creates a factual bias that ignores aleatoric uncertainty in opinion-rich content and risks erasing minority voices or enabling opinion manipulation. It proposes Opinion-Aware RAG, which adds LLM-extracted entity-linked opinion metadata before indexing and reduced Wasserstein distance to corpus sentiment distributions by 18-48% on two datasets, with human evaluators preferring its responses 79.2% of the time.

items.title: From Handwriting to Structured Data: Benchmarking AI Digitisation of Handwritten Forms
items.title_zh: 从手写到结构化数据：基准测试 AI 对手写表单的数字化
items.summary: The study benchmarks 17 frontier multimodal and open-source models on a challenging real-world medical handwritten form, finding the latest Google and OpenAI models reach accuracies around 85% with weighted F1 near 90% on discrete fields. GPT-5.4 had the lowest hallucination rate at 6%, Gemini 3.1 delivered the best overall performance, and prompt optimization raised macro precision, recall and F1 by over 60% while barely moving weighted metrics.

items.title: Peer-Predictive Self-Training for Language Model Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向语言模型推理的同伴预测自训练
items.summary: PST is a label-free fine-tuning framework in which multiple language models generate responses sequentially and the cross-model aggregate, often more reliable than individual answers, serves as an internal training signal weighted by pointwise mutual information. On math reasoning benchmarks it improves exact-match accuracy by 2.2-4.3 points across three small models and reduces the generator-verifier gap by 26-40% without external supervision.

items.title: Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve
items.title_zh: Evo-MedAgent：以会记忆、反思与改进的智能体超越一次性诊断
items.summary: Evo-MedAgent equips a frozen medical agent with test-time inter-case learning through three memory stores: retrospective clinical episodes, an adaptive procedural heuristics bank that evolves via reflection, and a tool reliability controller. On ChestAgentBench it raises multiple-choice accuracy from 0.68 to 0.79 on GPT-5-mini and from 0.76 to 0.87 on Gemini-3 Flash with no training, adding only one retrieval pass and one reflection call per case.

items.title: "Excuse me, may I say something..." CoLabScience, A Proactive AI Assistant for Biomedical Discovery and LLM-Expert Collaborations
items.title_zh: 「打扰一下，我能说两句吗……」CoLabScience：面向生物医学发现与 LLM-专家协作的主动式助手
items.summary: CoLabScience is a proactive LLM assistant for biomedical collaboration built on PULI, an RL-trained framework that decides when and how to intervene in streaming scientific discussions using the team's proposal and conversational memory. The authors also introduce BSDD, a benchmark of simulated research dialogues with intervention points derived from PubMed articles.

items.title: Agentic Large Language Models for Training-Free Neuro-Radiological Image Analysis
items.title_zh: 面向神经影像分析的免训练智能体大语言模型
items.summary: A training-free agentic pipeline has LLMs including GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Sonnet 4.6 orchestrate off-the-shelf tools for brain MRI workflows, from preprocessing and tumor segmentation to longitudinal assessment. The authors release a benchmark of image-prompt-answer tuples.

items.title: Abstain-R1: Calibrated Abstention and Post-Refusal Clarification via Verifiable RL
items.title_zh: Abstain-R1：通过可验证强化学习实现校准弃答与拒答后澄清
items.summary: The authors propose a clarification-aware RLVR reward that jointly optimizes explicit abstention and semantically aligned post-refusal clarification on unanswerable queries while still rewarding correct answers on answerable ones. A trained 3B model, Abstain-R1, improves on Abstain-Test, Abstain-QA and SelfAware and reaches unanswerable-query behavior competitive with larger systems including DeepSeek-R1.

items.title: GraphDC: A Divide-and-Conquer Multi-Agent System for Scalable Graph Algorithm Reasoning
items.title_zh: GraphDC：面向可扩展图算法推理的分治多智能体系统
items.summary: GraphDC splits an input graph into subgraphs, assigns each to a specialized agent and uses a master agent to combine local results with inter-subgraph information. The authors report consistent gains over existing methods, especially on larger graphs.

items.title: Agents Explore but Agents Ignore: LLMs Lack Environmental Curiosity
items.title_zh: 智能体会探索却不会利用：LLM 缺乏环境好奇心
items.summary: Across Terminal-Bench, SWE-Bench and AppWorld, the authors inject complete task solutions into agent environments and find agents discover them in 79-81% of Terminal-Bench runs but exploit them in only 37-50% of cases. In AppWorld, agents see documentation stating a command returns the full solution in over 90% of attempts yet exploit it in fewer than 7%, a gap the authors attribute to missing environmental curiosity and link to available tools, test-time compute and training data distribution.

items.title: PV-SQL: Synergizing Database Probing and Rule-based Verification for Text-to-SQL Agents
items.title_zh: PV-SQL：结合数据库探测与规则验证的 Text-to-SQL Agent
items.summary: PV-SQL is an agentic text-to-SQL framework whose Probe component queries the database to resolve ambiguities in value formats, column semantics and table relationships, while its Verify component builds an executable checklist from rule-based conditions. It reports a 5% execution-accuracy gain over the best baseline on BIRD.

items.title: codejunkie99/agentic-stack
items.title_zh: codejunkie99/agentic-stack：跨 Agent 工具的可移植记忆与技能
items.summary: agentic-stack provides a portable .agent/ folder containing memory, skills and protocols that works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode and other harnesses, so its knowledge persists when users switch tools.

items.title: ciembor/agent-rules-books
items.title_zh: ciembor/agent-rules-books：取材经典编程书的 Agent 规则集
items.summary: A collection of AGENTS.md rules and skills for AI coding agents such as Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, drawing on programming books including Clean Code, Refactoring, Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture and Designing Data-Intensive Applications.

items.title: espressif/esp-claw
items.title_zh: espressif/esp-claw：面向 IoT 设备的“聊天编程”AI 智能体框架
items.summary: ESP-Claw is a C-based AI agent framework for IoT devices from Espressif that takes a chat-coding approach to building device behavior.

items.title: Introducing GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
items.title_zh: 推出 GPT-Rosalind：面向生命科学研究的前沿推理模型
items.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-Rosalind, a frontier reasoning model built to accelerate drug discovery, genomics analysis, protein reasoning and scientific research workflows.

items.title: Jupiter-N Technical Report
items.title_zh: Jupiter-N 技术报告
items.summary: Jupiter-N is a hybrid reasoning model post-trained from the fully open-source 120B Nemotron 3 Super, targeting agentic capability via uncertainty-curated trajectories, UK cultural alignment and Welsh language support. Using the Forget-Me-Not framework to mix on-policy synthetic replay with off-policy task data, it gains +18 on ARC-Easy and +5.25 on MMLU-Lite for Welsh, +9.1 on Terminal Bench 2 and +4.4 on IFBench while retaining base capabilities, with weights and post-training data released openly.

items.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: Agentic coding power, now open to all
items.title_zh: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B：Agent 编程能力，向所有人开放
items.summary: Qwen released Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, presented as bringing agentic coding power and now open to all. The accompanying blog lists capabilities spanning chat, image and video understanding, image generation, document processing, web search, tool use and artifacts.

items.title: Apr 13, 2026 Product Introducing ParseBench: The First Document Parsing Benchmark for AI Agents Read
items.title_zh: 推出 ParseBench：首个面向 AI 智能体阅读的文档解析基准
items.summary: LlamaIndex announced ParseBench, described as the first document parsing benchmark for how AI agents read documents; the captured excerpt contains no further detail on its tasks or results.

items.title: Enterprises power agentic workflows in Cloudflare Agent Cloud with OpenAI
items.title_zh: 企业在 Cloudflare Agent Cloud 上借助 OpenAI 驱动智能体工作流
items.summary: Cloudflare is bringing OpenAI's GPT-5.4 and Codex to Agent Cloud so enterprises can build, deploy and scale AI agents for real-world tasks with speed and security.

items.title: The next evolution of the Agents SDK
items.title_zh: Agents SDK 的下一次演进
items.summary: OpenAI updated its Agents SDK with native sandbox execution and a model-native harness, aimed at helping developers build secure, long-running agents that work across files and tools.

items.title: Codex for (almost) everything
items.title_zh: Codex 升级：几乎什么都能做
items.summary: The updated Codex app for macOS and Windows adds computer use, in-app browsing, image generation, memory and plugins, with the aim of accelerating developer workflows.

items.title: Laravel raised money and now injects ads directly into your agent
items.title_zh: Laravel 融资后直接把广告塞进你的 Agent
items.summary: According to the article, Laravel Boost now tells AI coding agents that Laravel Cloud is the best deployment option and does not mention alternatives, raising the question of whether this is the future of advertising aimed at agents.
